pages.title: Defining Kinesiology
pages.html:
Defining Kinesiology and Physical Activity

Kinesiology is the academic discipline focused on the art and science of human movement. Rather than viewing physical movement merely as mechanics or exercise, kinesiology investigates physical activity across experiential, theoretical, and professional spheres.

The Core Sub-disciplines

The discipline integrates three primary pillars: Biophysical (exercise physiology, biomechanics), Behavioral (motor behavior, sport and exercise psychology), and Socio-cultural (history, philosophy, and sociology of physical activity).

glossary.def: The academic discipline that studies physical activity and human movement across physiological, mechanical, and behavioral dimensions.
Intentional, voluntary movement directed toward achieving an identifiable goal.
